label: AngularJS (1.x)
note: End of life since 2022-01-01; no security patches.

label: Python 2
note: End of life since 2020-01-01.

label: Azure AD B2C
note: Not sold to new customers since 2025-05-01; Microsoft points new projects to Entra External ID.

label: MongoDB Realm / Atlas Device Sync
note: Atlas Device Sync and the Realm SDKs were deprecated with end of life on 2025-09-30.

label: Create React App
note: Deprecated by the React team in February 2025; use Vite or a framework.

label: .NET Framework / Web Forms
note: Maintenance only, no new features; new work should target modern .NET.

label: End-of-life Node.js release
note: Node.js 20 and older releases are past end of life; use an active LTS release.

label: Firebase Dynamic Links
note: Shut down on 2025-08-25.

label: AWS CodeCommit
note: Closed to new customers on 2024-07-25.

label: Spring Boot 2.x
note: Open-source support for 2.7 ended in 2023-11; upgrade to 3.x.

label: Windows Server 2012 / 2012 R2
note: Extended support ended on 2023-10-10.

label: CentOS 7 / 8
note: End of life (CentOS 7 on 2024-06-30, CentOS 8 in 2021).

label: Python 3.8 or older
note: Python 3.8 reached end of life in October 2024.

label: Heroku free tier
note: Free dynos and databases were removed in November 2022.

label: SQL Server 2014 / 2016 or older
note: SQL Server 2014 ended extended support in July 2024 and SQL Server 2016 on 2026-07-14; older versions ended earlier.

label: MySQL 5.7 or older
note: MySQL 5.7 reached end of life in October 2023.

label: Vue 2
note: Vue 2 reached end of life on 2023-12-31.

label: PHP 7.4 or older, PHP 8.0
note: PHP 7.4 and 8.0 no longer receive security fixes (ended 2022-11 and 2023-11).

label: Ubuntu 20.04 or older
note: Ubuntu 18.04 standard support ended in 2023-05 and 20.04 in 2025-05; later updates need paid Ubuntu Pro.

label: PostgreSQL 13 or older
note: PostgreSQL 13 reached end of life on 2025-11-13; older majors ended earlier.

label: SQL Server 2017 / 2019
note: Still supported but past mainstream support (2019: mainstream ended 2025-02-28, security fixes until 2030-01-08; 2017: security fixes until 2027-10-12). Plan the upgrade or a move to a managed SQL service as part of this project.
